header.title: InputMask
header.description: Text field that formats the value in real time from a pattern: dates, times, phones, cards or your own mask. It inherits the look of InputText.

playground.title: Playground
playground.description: Try the main props and copy the generated code.
playground.label: Value
playground.helperText: The value is formatted as you type.

base.title: Base
base.description: `preset="date"` formats digits as DD/MM/YYYY. `prefixIcon` adds a decorative icon.

texts.label: Date
texts.helperText: Typed digits are formatted as DD/MM/YYYY.

prefixText.title: Prefix text
prefixText.description: `prefix` accepts text, an icon or any React node.

texts.label: Phone
texts.helperText: prefix can be text, an icon, or any React node.

texts.label: Card
texts.helperText: suffix sits after the formatted value.

prefixAndSuffix.title: Prefix and suffix
prefixAndSuffix.description: Mix text, Typography or icons in either slot.

texts.label: Card
texts.helperText: Mix text, Typography, or icons in either slot.

prefixIconAndText.title: Prefix icon and text
prefixIconAndText.description: With both `prefixIcon` and prefix, the icon comes first.

texts.label: Date
texts.helperText: prefixIcon renders before prefix when both are set.

customMask.title: Custom mask
customMask.description: `mask` takes precedence over `preset`. 9 is a digit, A a letter and S an alphanumeric; everything else is a separator.

outlineLabel.title: Outline label
outlineLabel.description: `labelPlacement="outline"` places the label on the top border, same as InputText.

texts.label: Phone
texts.helperText: Same outline label as Input Text.

clearable.title: Clearable
clearable.description: `clearable` shows a button that empties the field while it has a value. It clears through the normal `onChange` path, so it works the same controlled or uncontrolled, and then fires `onClear`. `clearLabel` is the button's accessible name; it defaults to "Clear". The value is cleared through the mask and emits an empty value.

texts.label: Phone
texts.helperText: The button shows while the field has a value.

valuePayload.title: Value payload
valuePayload.description: `onValueChange` receives the formatted value, the unmasked value and whether it is complete.

texts.label: Date
texts.helperText: onValueChange reports formatted and raw values.

presets.title: Presets
presets.description: Some of the built-in patterns, with their mask as helper text.

tailwind.brandHelper: Secondary accent and pill shape with cn() on wrapperClassName.
tailwind.mergedHelper: radius-xs replaces radius-full thanks to tailwind-merge.

css.label: Branded phone
css.helperText: Tertiary tokens and lg radius redefined on the container class.

header.title: InputMask API
header.description: API reference for the InputMask React component: props, events, utilities, CSS classes, variables, tokens and exported types.

demos.title: Demos
demos.description: For examples and usage details, visit the component demos page.

import.title: Import
import.description: Import it from the main entry or from its subpath to load only this component. The utilities to apply masks outside the component are exported too.

presets.title: Presets
presets.description: Built-in patterns. `mask` takes precedence over `preset`; with neither, date is used.

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: InputMask wraps InputText: it accepts its props and native <input> attributes (InputHTMLAttributes) except size, prefix, type, value and defaultValue, which are redefined. className goes to the <input> and wrapperClassName to the container, which also gets the gem-input-mask class.

a11y.title: Accessibility
a11y.inputMode: inputMode="numeric" is set when the mask only accepts digits, so mobile devices show the numeric keyboard.
a11y.autoComplete: Date, phone and card presets fill autoComplete (bday, tel, cc-number).
a11y.label: The label is linked with htmlFor; helperText and errorMessage are linked with aria-describedby and the error uses role="alert".

cssClasses.title: CSS classes
cssClasses.description: InputMask adds gem-input-mask to the container; the rest of the classes come from InputText.

rules.clear: Clear button. Shown with `clearable` while the field has a value.
rules.label: Field label.
rules.field: Container for the input and its icons.
rules.hasPrefix: Applied when prefix or `prefixIcon` is set.
rules.hasSuffix: Applied when suffix or `suffixIcon` is set.

cssVariables.title: CSS variables
cssVariables.description: InputText variables the component computes by measuring the prefix and suffix, applied as inline style on the root. Read them from your CSS; a class cannot override them.

items.--gem-input-prefix-pad: Measured prefix width; used as the input left padding.
items.--gem-input-suffix-pad: Measured suffix width; used as the input right padding.

tokens.title: Tokens
tokens.description: gem-system tokens used by the field. Redefine them in your `wrapperClassName` to change only this field.

items.--gem-color-accent: Focus border and focused outline label.

types.title: Exported types
types.description: Available from @gem-org/gem-system to type your own wrappers.

props.title: Props
props.description: It also accepts InputText props and native <input> attributes except size, prefix, type, value and `defaultValue`.

items.mask: Pattern with 9 (digit), A (letter), S (alphanumeric) and separators. Takes precedence over `preset`. Use \\ to force a literal.
items.preset: Built-in pattern, e.g. date, date-iso, time, phone or card.
items.definitions: Extra or replacement pattern tokens, merged with the defaults.
items.type: Native input type. Defaults to tel for phone presets.
items.placeholder: Defaults to the preset placeholder (e.g. DD/MM/YYYY).
items.maxLength: Defaults to the length of the formatted pattern.
items.label: Visible field label.
items.labelPlacement: Label position: above or on the border.
items.helperText: Hint below the field (hidden when `errorMessage` is shown).
items.errorMessage: Error copy. Marks the field as invalid.
items.infoText: Shows an info icon with this content.
items.infoLabel: Accessible name of the info icon.
items.prefix: Content before the value: text, icon or any node.
items.suffix: Content after the value: text, icon or any node.
items.prefixIcon: Decorative icon before the value (renders before prefix).
items.suffixIcon: Decorative icon after the value (renders after suffix).
items.border: Border tone. Forced to error when the field is invalid.
items.validRegex: Pattern the value must match. Failing values show the error border.
items.isRequired: Marks the field as required (aria-required + asterisk).
items.clearable: Shows a button that empties the field while it has a value.
items.clearLabel: Accessible name of the clear button.
items.wrapperClassName: Extra classes for the root container.
items.onChange: Native event. event.target.value is the formatted value.
items.onValueChange: Receives { value, unmaskedValue, isComplete } on every change.
items.onComplete: Fires when the value becomes complete.
items.onValidate: Fires when validity changes based on `validRegex`.
items.onInfoClick: Fires when the info icon is activated.
items.onClear: Fires after the field is cleared with the button.
